_comment: Backlog Momentum bucket. Manually populated from 10-Q filings and earnings supplements. Only tickers in BACKLOG_RELEVANT_TICKERS (components_grid and epc domains) carry entries. Update each earnings cycle.

BWXT.source: BWXT Q2 2026 10-Q — record $8.40B backlog vs $6.00B Q2 2025 (+40% YoY). BTB 1.70x TTM. Management cited multi-decade nuclear growth super-cycle driven by accelerated U.S. naval nuclear components procurement.

GEV.source: GEV Q2 2026 earnings supplement — $176.0B total backlog, equipment backlog $88.0B (+77% YoY). Quarterly orders $24.2B vs $11.1B revenue. Data center grid electrification and multi-GW gas/nuclear turbine pipelines drove $13.0B sequential expansion.

FLS.source: FLS Q2 2026 10-Q — $3.34B backlog vs $2.87B Q2 2025 (+16.3% YoY). Bookings $1.35B vs $1.17B revenue. Nuclear bookings exceeded $110M driven by life extension projects in North America and large-reactor pump/valve allocations in Asia.

IR.source: IR Q2 2026 earnings call — short-cycle manufacturing model, no consolidated multi-year backlog reported. Orders $2,042.9M vs revenue $2,049.0M (BTB 1.00x). Organic orders +2% YoY. Management flagged low-double-digit to mid-teens order acceleration in July as long-cycle infrastructure projects cleared bottlenecks. backlog_growth_yoy intentionally null.

J.source: Jacobs FQ3 2026 — $28.89B backlog vs $22.70B prior year (+27.3% YoY). BTB 1.20x quarterly, 1.40x TTM. Data center segment +100% YoY, AI infrastructure pipeline +400% with visibility into 2028.

FLR.source: FLR Q2 2026 — $26.90B backlog, flat/slightly down YoY (impacted by $650M Mexico JV divestiture removal). New awards $6.1B vs $4.33B quarterly revenue (BTB 1.41x). 85% of active backlog now reimbursable/cost-plus. Execution turnaround expected to filter into ROIC by 2027. NQS gate remains locked on negative fundamentals despite healthy new award flow.
